points.description: States that bulb A is still in a complete/closed circuit (closed path) with the battery and switch Z, so current can flow through it. Equivalent wording accepted (e.g. 'current can still flow through A via Z', 'A is in a separate/parallel loop with the battery that is not broken by Y being open'). Do not award for just 'Z is closed' or 'electricity flows' with no reference to a complete path/circuit containing A.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying bulb A is in a complete closed circuit with the battery and closed switch Z, so current flows. No marks for only stating that Z is closed or that Y being open has no effect, without mention of a complete path or current flowing through A.
